grammar.summary: 本课学习将来进行时表按计划即将发生。

points.title: 将来进行时 will be doing
points.explanation: 表示将来某时段按计划进行的动作：The Greenwood Boys will be arriving tomorrow. 强调"已安排好"，比 will do 更确定。

examples.en: They will be coming by train.
The police will be trying to keep order.

points.title: 时间介词 during
points.explanation: during + 名词表"在……期间"：during this time / during the three days。

examples.en: They will be staying for five days.
